slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

new places, alone

once a week, walk into a cafe, gym or shop you've never been to, alone, and act like you've been coming for years. confidence is mostly behaving like you belong before you feel it.

returning things

this month, return one thing you're unhappy with, in person: cold food, the wrong size, a bad repair. calmly saying "this isn't right" gets easier every single time you do it.

front row only

for a month, sit in the front row at every class, talk or meeting you go to. there's nowhere to hide up there, and that is exactly the point. hiding is a habit too.

culture snacks

spend 5 minutes a day learning one surprising thing about history, art or science. knowing a little about a lot lets you walk into any conversation without the panic of having nothing to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
windows down singing

sing one full song with the car or bedroom window open, at real volume. the fear of being heard is always bigger than the few people who actually hear you.
